name: Workflow
description: A state machine on the instance: a status that starts in the initial state and changes only through transition, along a transition the config lists. A transition may name a permission the caller must hold. A state that no transition leaves is terminal, and a terminal state has an outcome: success, failure or neutral, success unless the config says otherwise. Other instances' blockers, rollups and reactions read it.

finished.description: The outcome of each state it names that a transition leaves: success, failure or neutral. Such a state counts as finished for the rules that read an outcome, as a terminal state does, though a row may leave it: a task that is done and may be reopened. Each key is a state of states that a transition leaves; a terminal state's outcome is outcomes'. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

initial.description: The state a new instance starts in; the first of states when absent.

outcomes.description: The outcome of each terminal state it names: success, failure or neutral. A terminal state it does not name is a success. Each key is a terminal state of states.

overridePermission.description: The permission that lets a caller make a transition its by does not name them for; the transition's own permission is still needed. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

repeat.description: unchanged: a transition to the state the instance is in answers { from, to, unchanged: true } and writes nothing, before any other behavior's guard is asked. Absent, it is the veto already_in_state. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

states.description: Every state an instance can be in.

transitions.description: The moves the status may make. A state that no transition leaves is terminal.

by.description: Who may make this transition: fields of the instance that hold a subject, createdBy among them, and seats of the table's Seats, each as seat:<name>. Only a caller who is the subject one of the fields holds, or who is seated in one of the seats, may, and it needs the transition's permission too when it names one; a field with no value names no one. A caller holding the config's overridePermission may whatever the fields and the seats hold. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

from.description: The state the instance is in.

permission.description: The permission a caller needs to make this transition. Absent, any caller who may write the instance can.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The state the instance is in.

fields.name: enteredAt
fields.description: When the status last changed, in epoch milliseconds: the create's time, then each transition's. Absent on an instance created before Workflow kept it, until its next transition.

operations.name: transition
operations.description: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

from.description: The state the caller read the instance in. An instance in another state refuses the move as the veto stale, before anything else is checked, so a retry that finds its move made is stale with the state it moved to. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.
The state the instance was in.

to.description: The state it is in now.

unchanged.description: True when the instance was already in to and the config's repeat is unchanged, so nothing was written; absent otherwise.

vetoes.description: The instance is already in the state the transition names.
The instance is in a terminal state: no transition leaves it.
No transition of the config leads from the instance's state to the one named.
The instance has no status to move from.
The transition names who may make it (by), and the caller is none of them and holds no overridePermission.
The caller named the state it read (from), and the instance is in another.
